_doc: Town-screen building sprites remade cute and chunky (bead bzc.98) in the style of the bzc.97 map towns: one 64x64 sprite per building of each v0.2 faction's tree, a single toy-like building in three-quarter view from slightly above, thick black outline, rounded chunky shapes, lit from the bottom left. Style image: the faction's accepted chunky map town (palette, outline, pixel size and shapes only). One generate-image-v2 call at 64x64 returns 16 candidates that follow a mixed subject's list in order ('each image a different one of these'); each accepted candidate's verdict starts with the building id it shows, and outputs[] maps it to its file. Replaces set town-buildings (bzc.15), which keeps its history but derives no game files. Class contract: docs/art/classes/towns.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: each image a different one of these 5 cute steampunk dwarf buildings, three takes of each in this order: Marketplace (a stone market stall with a teal and white striped awning, crates and a brass scale); Resource Silo (a riveted copper hopper on iron legs with a chute over an ore cart); Deep Shaft (a mine head: a big iron winding wheel on a timber frame, an ore cart on rails); Repair Yard (a stone shed with a verdigris roof and an iron crane holding a little brass machine by a hook); The Great Boiler (a giant free-standing brass boiler, a huge pressure gauge on its front and a steam whistle on top). Colours: warm grey stone #9a8f80, verdigris teal #3aa38f, brass #d9a634, copper #c7683a, dark iron #4a4f57.

recipes.concept: REALM harbour: Royal Docks, Harbour Light, Admiralty
